notes: IMPORTANT AMBIGUITY: pricelawgroup.com 301-redirects to resolvelawgroup.com, and on first fetch resolvelawgroup.com served a 5-second JS auto-refresh 'One moment, please...' interstitial (anti-bot) rather than real content - a second fetch (or one with a persisted cookie jar) got through to real HTML, so fetch_blocked is set true to flag that this firm's real site needs a retry/cookie-jar technique, not a one-shot curl. The site's application/ld+json (repeated identically across multiple attorney pages, including oddly referencing 'Blitz Law Group' in one description field, suggesting a reused/templated schema block) names 'Allen Jones III' as founder - however, the same schema's organization-level email is 'stuart@resolvelawgroup.com', which by name plausibly belongs to Stuart Price, the attorney whose name is literally in 'Price Law Group.' Given the schema is templated/possibly unreliable, a human should sanity-check whether Allen Jones III or Stuart Price is the right addressee before sending. Neither has a personal email confirmed beyond the ambiguous org-level stuart@ address, which was NOT attributed to Allen Jones III in emails_found since the name doesn't match him.
